image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a dark-shelled turtle (likely a mud or musk turtle) walking through dry grass and dirt. The turtle's carapace is dark brown/black with visible scute patterns and some yellowish speckling. The head is extended, showing a pointed snout and small eye with yellowish markings on the neck. One front limb is visible, appearing stout with claws. The background consists of out-of-focus dry vegetation.
